# Set81 clock-only oracle correction

This overlay preserves the original `oracle/` freeze byte for byte. Apply its five exact field replacements to the uniquely identified cases in the pinned table; do not recopy or regenerate the seven inputs.

Selected nonhistorical preflight runs before the readiness pause. It may sample and durably advance the original clock even when the later admission result is busy. Those paths still perform no node admission and create no birth, receipt sequence, ownership admission outbox item or signed publication. Historical recovery retains its clock-free path.

Clock-only write failure remains outcome-unknown and poisonous, with uncertain metadata durability. Its admission-count tuple is nevertheless exactly `(0,0,0,0)` because no admission or publication was staged. This does not assert a disk rollback.

Root and peer source review identified these five clarifications before Set81 implementation. This correction does not claim a product run or exact-tip CI success. The base remains Set80 `ce9eac7463a75d2ba7e0cefc8924f55d6c77b0a9`; a later maintenance rebind belongs to root.
